causalAutopsy.notes: PresenceProxy predates Slack support. When Slack arrived its arming was added INSIDE the existing Telegram-gated block rather than beside it, so the feature read as cross-platform in the source while being unreachable on a Slack-only agent. Latent since Slack support landed; invisible because the missing log line is itself inside the block that never runs.

classClosure.reason: No new self-triggered loop: an existing watcher with its own tier timers, speaker election and budgets is constructed on a platform where it previously was not. Cadence and brakes unchanged.
